reserve_basis: Conservative allocation of the existing project budget for unreconciled historical spending; not observed spending.

calculation.input_bound_method: UTF-8 byte-count allowance using maximum indexed source serialization, longest benchmark question, system prompt and 5000 additional framing bytes. Actual usage remains provider-reported.
calculation.conversion_note: Conservative budget allowance, not a quoted exchange rate.
calculation.threshold_review: Historical reserve plus estimated remaining calls checked against £40 review and £50 allocation. No unrecorded historical cost has been recorded as zero.
